---
# Source: demo/templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: alpha-db
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: demo
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: alpha
    helm.sh/chart: demo-0.1.0
type: Opaque
stringData:
  host: "db.example"
  password: "user-password-r1"
data:
  token: "dG9rZW4tZm9yLWFscGhh"

---
# Source: demo/charts/sub/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: alpha-sub
data:
  greeting: "hello from parent"
  subOnly: 
  region: "us-east"

---
# Source: demo/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: alpha-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: demo
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: alpha
    helm.sh/chart: demo-0.1.0
data:
  replicas: "2"
  image: "registry.example/demo:1.1"
  region: "us-east"
  fromSub: "42"
  app.toml: |
    [server]
    listen = "0.0.0.0:8080"
    

---
# Source: demo/templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: alpha-svc
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: demo
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: alpha
    helm.sh/chart: demo-0.1.0
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: alpha
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
